bio: This appealing country house lies above a small lake, in the town's Schönstädt neighbourhood. Hannes Scammell shows his culinary mettle, cooking up fresh and tasty seasonal dishes. You can also dine outside. At lunchtime, the menu is somewhat reduced. The good cuisine is complemented by the friendly service provided by the hostess. Barbecue fans, take note: they also organise regular evening events dedicated to grilled meats....
